_doc: Pinned thresholds for the hermetic CI gate (P13 of docs/RAG_QA_PLAN.md, §9.3).
The smoke test in test_eval_smoke.py asserts the in-memory eval run is at-or-above
these floors. They are deliberately tight against the fake graph used in conftest.py:
any regression in the orchestrator wiring (term extraction, RRF fusion, hydration,
rerank pass-through) should drop one of these below threshold and fail the gate.
When updating: bump the floors when the in-memory fake gets richer, NOT when a
regression makes a metric drop. The whole point is that this file is the
contract — code follows numbers, not the other way around.

live_targets._note: Targets from §9.2 of the plan — measured by run_rag_eval.py against staging.
